name: create_folder
description:
Creates new folders in Box.

<examples>
Create folder in root:
<input>
{
  "name": "Project Documents"
}
</input>

Create folder in specific parent:
<input>
{
  "name": "Q4 Reports",
  "parent_folder_id": "123456789"
}
</input>
</examples>

name.description: Folder name (max 255 chars, no slashes, leading/trailing spaces, or dots). Must be unique within parent folder.

parent_folder_id.description: Parent folder ID where new folder will be created. Defaults to "0" (root directory).
